source: GET https://api.machgen.ai/api/v0/billing/pricebook/public (no authentication); the JSON the www.machgen.ai/pricing page renders. Video rows only, pricing fields only.
note: Exact micro-USD rates. The rendered page rounds to three decimals (MiniMax-H3 480p 16-30 s shows 0.018; unit_price_micros is 17500). A row whose task_type is null applies to task types without their own row (for MiniMax-H3, R2V and task_type F2F); MiniMax-H3-MultiMax is the API's MiniMax-H3-Turbo; discounted_unit_price_micros is the price billed until discount_ends_at.
